relationships.subject: tFNA-KLT
relationships.evidence_quote: We demonstrated that tFNA-KLT can significantly increase the number and area of sprouts in the three-dimensional spheroid-sprouting assay

relationships.subject: tFNA-KLT
relationships.evidence_quote: The results showed that tFNA-KLT can effectively prevent the occurrence of BRONJ by accelerating angiogenesis.

relationships.subject: KLT
relationships.evidence_quote: KLT (Acetyl-KLTWQELYQLKYKGI-amide, also named QK) is a VEGF-mimic peptide, which can bind and then activate the VEGF receptor and play a function similar to VEGF.

relationships.subject: bisphosphonates
relationships.evidence_quote: Previous reports have shown that bisphosphonates can inhibit the proliferative activity of endothelial cells (ECs) and the expression of angiogenic growth factors and then inhibit angiogenesis.

key_findings: tFNA-KLT nanoparticle promoted endothelial proliferation, migration and angiogenesis in vitro, ex vivo and in vivo, more strongly than tFNA or KLT alone.
Local tFNA-KLT prevented BRONJ in a rat tooth extraction model by promoting angiogenesis.
